direct_test_mode_overview: Volume 6 Part F (Direct Test Mode) defines a test interface allowing a tester to drive the controller into a deterministic RF state (LE Test, LE Transmitter Test, LE Receiver Test, LE Test End) over either HCI or a 2-wire UART for production-line / certification testing. All 40 channels can be selected; LE 1M, LE 2M, LE Coded S=2, LE Coded S=8 are supported.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_TRANSMITTER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Start transmitter test on a given channel with a given packet pattern (PRBS9 / 11110000 / 10101010 / PRBS15 / all-1 / all-0 / 0000_1111 / 0101_0101) and length.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_RECEIVER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Start receiver test on a given channel; reports number of packets received.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_TEST_END
dtm_command_set.purpose: End the test; for receiver test returns packet count; for transmitter returns success only.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_ENHANCED_TRANSMITTER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Like LE_TRANSMITTER_TEST but parameterized by PHY (1M / 2M / Coded S=2 / Coded S=8) and modulation index (Standard / Stable).

dtm_command_set.name: LE_ENHANCED_RECEIVER_TEST
dtm_command_set.purpose: Like LE_RECEIVER_TEST with PHY + modulation-index selection.

dtm_command_set.name: LE_TRANSMITTER_TEST_v3
dtm_command_set.purpose: Adds antenna-switching pattern (CTE) for direction-finding test (BLE 5.1).

dtm_command_set.name: LE_RECEIVER_TEST_v3
dtm_command_set.purpose: Adds antenna-switching pattern for AoA test (BLE 5.1).

test_modes_high_speed_only_compat: Not applicable — BLE has no equivalent of USB 'HS test modes'; DTM is the standardized production-line test mechanism.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI Read RSSI
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Returns RSSI value in dBm for a given connection handle.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI LE Read Channel Map
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Returns the 37-bit Channel Map currently in use for a connection.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI LE Read Remote Features
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Triggers LL_FEATURE_REQ + reports remote LL feature bitmap.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI Read Local Supported Features
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Returns the controller's supported LMP / LL feature bitmap.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI LE Read Local P-256 Public Key
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Returns local ECDH P-256 public key for LE Secure Connections debug.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI LE Enhanced Read Transmit Power Level (BLE 5.2)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Returns current + max TX power for a given PHY + connection handle.

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI LE Path Loss Threshold Event (BLE 5.2)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reports current path-loss zone transition (HIGH / MIDDLE / LOW).

spec_provided_observability.name: HCI LE Transmit Power Reporting Event (BLE 5.2)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Reports a remote-peer-driven TX power change.

error_detection_mechanisms: CRC-24 on every PDU (polynomial 0x100065B) — receivers silently drop CRC-failing PDUs.
Access Address mismatch — receiver discards packet at preamble correlation.
Per-PHY symbol-error correction: LE Coded S=2 uses BCH FEC over 4-bit blocks; LE Coded S=8 adds an 8x repetition stage.
Sequence Number / NESN tracking forces retransmission on dropped data PDUs in a connection.
Encryption MIC failure (AES-CCM 4-octet MIC) terminates the connection with reason 'MIC Failure' (0x3D).

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Scanner received a non-connectable advertising packet.
Scanner received any extended advertising packet.

interrupt_or_event_sources.event: HCI LE Periodic Advertising Sync Established
HCI LE Path Loss Threshold Event (BLE 5.2)
HCI LE Channel Selection Algorithm Event

notes: Beyond Direct Test Mode (Vol 6 Part F) and HCI status/event APIs, the spec leaves SoC-internal scan/JTAG/BIST to the chip integrator. Bluetooth Qualification (Profile Tuning Suite, PTS) tests cover protocol-level conformance and interoperability — they consume DTM + HCI but do not extend the spec itself.
